R01.title: 参考学习与可编辑科研 SVG

anchors.0: Data, pairing or units are substantially invented or lost.
anchors.2: Most values are represented, but one material design or unit ambiguity remains.
anchors.4: All supplied observations, pairing, batch identity and distinct experimental units are faithfully encoded; summaries are defined and justified.

rubric.name: Learning from all three actual figure references

anchors.0: No actual reference analysis or copied artwork replaces the new figure.
anchors.2: All references are named, but analysis is superficial or adoption is poorly connected to the data.
anchors.4: Specific visible choices from all three references are critically analysed and adapted coherently to the new scientific comparison.

anchors.0: Axes or uncertainty materially distort the scientific comparison.
anchors.2: Scales are plausible but a comparison, baseline or uncertainty definition is unclear.
anchors.4: Scale choices support both small changes and baseline context; comparison, sample unit and uncertainty meaning are explicit and defensible.

rubric.name: Composition, typography and accessible visual identity

anchors.0: Important labels or data are unreadable.
anchors.2: Figure is readable at large size but has crowding or inconsistent identities at target size.
anchors.4: Clear reading order, consistent identities, accessible redundant encodings and legible typography work at 180 mm.

rubric.name: Editable delivery, caption and targeted visual review

anchors.0: Required vector/source artifacts or meaningful caption are absent.
anchors.2: SVG and preview exist but editability, regeneration or review evidence is incomplete.
anchors.4: Live text, separate editable elements, reproducible source, self-contained caption and concrete inspection evidence support reuse.

requirements.requirement: No material fabrication or loss of supplied values, pairing, units or separate experiment identity.
An openable SVG with live text and separately editable scientific elements is delivered.
All three actual supplied figure references receive specific visual analysis.

required_observations.label: Read all three reference images and captions
Inspect SVG and PNG at 180 mm
Inspect live text, elements and source archive
Cross-check all observations, pairing and summaries
Read caption, design note and review

reviewer_checks: Open the three references: identify the actual visible choices claimed in the design note.
Inspect final-size panels; check transient device IDs remain local to their experiment.
Inspect SVG XML/live text and source archive rather than inferring editability from a PNG.

rating_scale.intermediate: 1 and 3 require evidence showing performance between the adjacent published anchors; they are not default uncertainty scores.

R02.title: 小差异、宽动态范围与删失数据绘图

rubric.name: Data parsing, observation status and measurement semantics

anchors.0: Censored, signed or paired observations are corrupted.
anchors.2: Data generally survive but a status or uncertainty definition is ambiguous.
anchors.4: Every row, pairing, status, unit and expanded-uncertainty definition survives the complete workflow.

rubric.name: Purposeful scale choices for nearby and broad-range values

anchors.0: A blanket scale rule produces misleading comparisons or drops data.
anchors.2: Scale choices are plausible but the rationale or baseline comparison is incomplete.
anchors.4: Axis-specific decisions explain absolute/relative comparisons, baseline, zero and dynamic range, with a useful diagnostic revealing tradeoffs.

anchors.0: Summary calculations or error definitions are materially wrong.
anchors.2: Main summaries are usable but limited reproducibility or one uncertainty ambiguity remains.
anchors.4: Paired summaries, interval rendering and any sensitivity assumptions are numerically traceable and scientifically defensible.

anchors.0: Important information is unreadable or unexplained.
anchors.2: Most labels and caption are usable with some omissions at final size.
anchors.4: The figure and caption explain units, experimental unit, intervals, censoring, limits and visual encodings at final size.

anchors.0: Source cannot regenerate the outputs.
anchors.2: Source runs with manual intervention or incomplete environment/decision records.
anchors.4: A documented local command reproduces vector/raster outputs, summary table and scale-decision record without network access.

requirements.requirement: Pairing, signed/zero values and censoring retain their distinct meanings without invented point estimates.
Actual generated figures are supplied.
Python source can regenerate the scientific figures from supplied data.

required_observations.label: Inspect main and alternative-scale figures at 180 mm
Attempt documented regeneration and record actual outcome
Verify parsing, paired summaries and U(k=2) intervals

reviewer_checks: Confirm S4/S8 have no measured point estimate; S1 remains negative and S2 zero.
Verify expanded uncertainty is U(k=2), not raw sample SD; inspect every relevant axis.
A failed documented regeneration is observed evidence; inability of the reviewer environment to execute is unassessed.

rating_scale.intermediate: 1 and 3 require evidence showing performance between the adjacent published anchors; they are not default uncertainty scores.

R03.title: 保持事实与证据强度的英文润色

rubric.name: Preservation of scientific facts and scope

anchors.0: Material numbers, design, uncertainty or limits are invented or lost.
anchors.2: Most facts survive but one material qualification or design detail is weakened.
anchors.4: Every material fact, quantity, design relationship, uncertainty and temporal limit is preserved or transparently queried.

rubric.name: Conservative treatment of unsupported scientific claims

anchors.0: Unsupported significance, mechanism or generalization is retained or strengthened without disclosure.
anchors.2: Some problematic wording is corrected but the disposition or author query is incomplete.
anchors.4: Unsupported claims are handled transparently and proportionately, with precise author queries where required and no invented supporting evidence.

rubric.name: Natural, precise English for the stated audience

anchors.0: The prose remains inflated, incoherent or unsuitable for a manuscript.
anchors.2: Readable prose still contains unnecessary staging, repetition or vague claims.
anchors.4: Connected, economical manuscript prose uses specific subjects and verbs, varied natural rhythm and appropriate scientific qualification.

anchors.0: No useful claim ledger exists to audit preservation of the scientific record.
anchors.2: A ledger covers numbers but omits causal, uncertainty or scope claims.
anchors.4: A complete and navigable ledger ties original claims to edits, factual status and transparent dispositions.

anchors.0: The output claims verification or detector success.
anchors.2: The boundary is implied but queries or length constraints are poorly handled.
anchors.4: All deliverables meet scope and length, distinguish editing from validation, and make remaining author decisions explicit.

requirements.requirement: All material quantitative/design/uncertainty/temporal facts remain faithful to the approved editorial record.
Unsupported significance, mechanism and long-term claims are explicitly removed, bounded or queried.
A useful claim-by-claim ledger includes F01–F11 and unsupported claims.

hard_caps.reason: Unsupported scientific certainty retained or strengthened

required_observations.label: Read the entire edited passage and memo
Trace every material claim through the ledger

reviewer_checks: Use R03 approved means, not values recalculated from R01/R04 fixtures.
p=0.08 is author-reported; no test family/statistic/interval or preregistered alpha was supplied.
Removing an unsupported claim with an explicit ledger entry is valid; require no invented substitute evidence.

rating_scale.intermediate: 1 and 3 require evidence showing performance between the adjacent published anchors; they are not default uncertainty scores.

R04.title: 从图版与数据撰写结果和讨论

rubric.name: Quantitative fidelity to the actual figure and data

anchors.0: The text misstates observations or invents numerical results.
anchors.2: Most values are traceable but a quantitative comparison or unit is incomplete.
anchors.4: Three or more scientifically useful numerical statements are correct, traceable to calculations and tied to the actual panels.

rubric.name: Reasoning across observation, interpretation and mechanism

anchors.0: Hypotheses or short-term observations are promoted to established mechanism or durability.
anchors.2: Interpretation is mostly restrained but an evidential boundary or experiment relationship remains unclear.
anchors.4: Results, inference and hypotheses are explicitly distinguished, experiments remain distinct and a discriminating follow-up has meaningful alternative predictions.

anchors.0: Paragraphs are disconnected, generic or unsuitable for a paper.
anchors.2: The narrative is understandable but repetitive or weakly organized around the scientific question.
anchors.4: Each paragraph has a clear scientific purpose and connected argument, with precise language and appropriately bounded significance.

rubric.name: Caption, units, interval and experimental structure

anchors.0: Caption materially misdefines the figure.
anchors.2: Caption is usable but omits one important definition or scope limit.
anchors.4: Caption accurately and independently explains both panels, independent units, batch encodings and interval definitions.

rubric.name: Claim audit and reproducible numerical support

anchors.0: No usable evidence table or calculation source exists.
anchors.2: Most claims map to sources but some rejected notes or calculations are not auditable.
anchors.4: A complete claim map distinguishes adopted and rejected notes, supports calculations with runnable code and states unresolved scientific limitations.

requirements.requirement: No invented data, inferred mechanism or unmeasured durability is presented as established.
Both actual input panels and the separate experiments are interpreted.
Quantitative claims have usable evidence links and reproducible calculations.

required_observations.label: Inspect F1a/F1b and their plotted encodings
Check adopted and rejected rough notes

reviewer_checks: F1a has individual paired observations; F1b is the distinct six-device experiment with arithmetic mean ± sample SD.
D08 has a negative paired change; evaluate claims of all-device improvement against that observation.
Require a meaningful predicted distinction between two alternatives in the proposed follow-up; no extra literature is needed.

rating_scale.intermediate: 1 and 3 require evidence showing performance between the adjacent published anchors; they are not default uncertainty scores.

R05.title: 文献证据综合与有界方法复现

rubric.name: 三文阅读、方法与材料边界

anchors.0: Central source methods, units or evidence types are wrong or one paper is ignored.
anchors.2: All sources are present but some denominators, evidence types or available-material limits are vague.
anchors.4: All three papers and relevant supplied P1 supplement are accurately read, with correct units/denominators, exact locations and bounded scope.

rubric.name: 跨来源综合与条件性工作流程

anchors.0: The review is unsupported summaries or universal design prescriptions.
anchors.2: A usable cross-source argument exists but tradeoffs or practical implications are incompletely justified.
anchors.4: A coherent argument connects the three sources, explains at least two conditional tradeoffs, distinguishes inference from author claims and gives a grounded workflow and testable gap.

anchors.0: Central citations are invented or the table creates false comparability.
anchors.2: Most claims are supported but exact locations or status distinctions are incomplete.
anchors.4: At least ten useful claims are traceable across prose/table/figures, at least three synthesis/inferred-premise rows are labelled, and all three bibliography records are accurate.

anchors.0: A required calculation is absent or substantially wrong or mislabelled.
anchors.2: Both demonstrations exist but a result, source-to-code mapping, pairing or metric definition is materially weak.
anchors.4: Both methods compute the required summaries/distances and diagnostics correctly, use exact source expressions/coordinates, and include a meaningful consistency check each.

rubric.name: 可复现交付与结论校准

anchors.0: Code/outputs are unusable or synthetic demos are claimed as full paper replication.
anchors.2: Artifacts mostly run but versions, commands or unreplicated boundaries remain unclear.
anchors.4: Documented local execution regenerates outputs, limitations and methodological ambiguities are explicit, and the closed evidence set is not called systematic or comprehensive.

requirements.requirement: No fabricated source, central material misreading, unperformed full reproduction or falsely systematic review.
Both bounded methods have actual numerical and graphical artifacts.
All three papers and relevant supplied P1 supplement are substantively used.

hard_caps.reason: A required method has no real output

required_observations.label: Read sufficient supplied source text/figures/S1 to judge claims
Audit prose, comparative table, ledger and bibliography
Attempt documented code and verify numerical results

reviewer_checks: Verify pairing is within each variant; do not let matching marginal summaries substitute for paired-difference analysis.
Check the expression actually printed in P3 Methods; a label or similarly named package is not evidence of the implemented metric.
Inspect missing-SI/code boundaries and do not impose absent source details as hidden requirements.
This merged task does not require separate long source cards, glossary or a second evidence-map SVG.

rating_scale.intermediate: 1 and 3 require evidence showing performance between the adjacent published anchors; they are not default uncertainty scores.

R06.title: 视频修改与参考视觉重建

A.title: 视频修改与参考视觉重建

anchors.0: No valid playable video or seriously corrupted media.
anchors.2: Playable video with a material size, frame-rate or decoding defect.
anchors.4: Complete 1920×1080 H.264 output, 24 fps and 240 frames, with no unintended corrupt or black frames.

anchors.0: Major scenes are missing, out of order or temporally unusable.
anchors.2: Six scenes are present but cuts, duration or transitions have substantial defects.
anchors.4: All six scenes and target intervals are clear; transitions and action establish coherent pacing without penalizing harmless one-frame overlap.

anchors.0: Studio background, rectangular source frame or major subject loss remains.
anchors.2: Subject is separated but green spill, edge chatter, floor mat or holes remain visibly distracting.
anchors.4: Hair, hands and moving contours remain stable; spill and studio artifacts are controlled without losing the subject or held object.

rubric.name: 排版与文字 / Typography and copy

anchors.0: Required copy is missing or largely unreadable.
anchors.2: Most copy is correct but hierarchy, placement or motion reduces readability.
anchors.4: All COPY.txt text is exact, clearly organized and legible; typography actively participates in the required animation.

anchors.0: Required mechanisms are absent or replaced by static images.
anchors.2: Recognizable motion exists but trajectories, easing or continuous mechanisms have major defects.
anchors.4: Orbit, waves, ribbons, iris and confetti show coherent trajectories, continuous motion, intentional speed and controlled transitions.

rubric.name: 遮挡与空间 / Occlusion and depth

anchors.0: Depth interactions are absent or faked only by global opacity.
anchors.2: Some depth cues work but orbit or ribbon ordering is inconsistent or incomplete.
anchors.4: Text and ribbon genuinely pass behind and in front of the actor with legible depth changes and sound layer ordering.

anchors.0: The sequence is incoherent, unfinished or unreadable.
anchors.2: A usable design exists but palette, spacing, framing or ending has visible weaknesses.
anchors.4: Six scenes form a consistent readable design with balanced color, spacing and framing, and a complete stable ending.

requirements.requirement: An actual complete playable output video exists.
The supplied actor/object and chronological one-to-one source time are retained.
Usable editable project/code is delivered.
The supplied soundtrack is included in full at its original rate without replacement.
Required source/font credits and modification notices are retained.
Mode was preregistered; A had no reference access; B did not copy reference frames into the output.

hard_caps.reason: Material loss/replacement of source identity or time

required_observations.label: Watch full output.mp4 with moving contours/text
Listen to candidate audio and compare supplied soundtrack

reviewer_checks: Confirm mode before exposing the candidate to any input; retain attempt/intervention record.
Record timecoded observations for all six scenes; contact sheets do not certify motion.
Actual audio listening and media probe are separate from visual scoring; decoded PCM need not be byte-identical after AAC compression.
No single pixel-error score substitutes for human evaluation.
Do not distribute evaluator or demo_project files.
Do not use author-reference likeness as an A criterion; do not expose the reference to the candidate.

rating_scale.intermediate: 1 and 3 require evidence showing performance between the adjacent published anchors; they are not default uncertainty scores.

H01.title: 聊天端单 HTML 科研工作台

anchors.0: Pairing, sign, censoring or uncertainty is materially corrupted.
anchors.2: Most data are preserved but one important interpretation or scale issue remains.
anchors.4: All views retain correct pairing, units, signs, missing/censored status and U(k=2) meaning with useful comparisons.

rubric.name: 筛选、详情返回与状态一致性

anchors.0: Controls are absent, inert or operate on unrelated static examples.
anchors.2: Main controls work but filtering/counts/details/return/reset are inconsistent in an important state.
anchors.4: Batch plus ID filtering, summaries, details, return, excluded selections, zero matches and reset all remain consistent across views.

rubric.name: 离线、真实导出与原子导入

anchors.0: HTML needs a server/network or export/import is fake or destroys state.
anchors.2: Most offline/export paths work but invalid-state handling or filtered CSV has a defect.
anchors.4: Single HTML works offline, exports actual current records, round-trips valid state and rejects invalid schema/data without partial mutation.

rubric.name: 布局、响应式与可访问性

anchors.0: Key content is unreadable or important controls cannot be operated.
anchors.2: Usable desktop view has meaningful narrow-screen/keyboard/alternative-data limitations.
anchors.4: Clear low-clutter layout works at 1280 and 390 px, keyboard controls have names, and data remain accessible without hover or color alone.

anchors.0: Claims of verified behavior are invented or no useful record exists.
anchors.2: A checklist exists but actual versus inferred outcomes or limits are vague.
anchors.4: Specific checks state browser/width/actions/outcomes and honestly separate real browser tests, code inspection and untested behavior.

requirements.requirement: Actual single-file HTML is delivered and usable offline.
Core controls update real data and state rather than only styling.
Pairing, signed values, censoring and uncertainty remain scientifically faithful.
Filtered CSV matches records and invalid state imports do not partially change the application.

hard_caps.reason: Export mismatch or destructive partial import

required_observations.label: Open actual HTML with network unavailable
Open actual downloaded CSV and state JSON
Test valid and malformed/invalid state imports
Cross-check values, statuses, summaries and intervals
Read declared test scope and compare to evidence

reviewer_checks.action: Reset, clear search, select all batches
reviewer_checks.expect: 12 paired devices; original pair data retained.

Shows B2, 1002.0 mV before and 1001.9 mV after, difference -0.1 mV within displayed rounding; return retains prior filter/search/view.
Zero devices; no stale summary or detail. Export disabled with local explanation OR valid header-only CSV.

reviewer_checks.action: Clear search, leave B2, export paired CSV
reviewer_checks.expect: Header device,batch,before_mV,after_mV and four original B2 rows; no hidden all-data export.

reviewer_checks.action: Export state, change filters and comparison, import exported state
reviewer_checks.expect: Valid nrb-h01-state-v1 restores all exported state and corresponding views.

reviewer_checks.expect: Useful local error; original state and embedded data unchanged in every case.
